en: Black‑and‑white river panorama taken from an elevated viewpoint. A paddle steamer travels along a broad river that curves through a town. On the left bank, closely packed houses rise up a hill crowned by a long rectangular building with a tall tower or steeple. In the middle distance are two bridges: one appears to be a suspension or chain bridge, and behind it a long multi‑arched stone or masonry railway viaduct. On the right, steep rocky cliffs rise directly from the river, with a small building or chapel visible at the cliff top. The distant background shows low mountains or large hills. The foreground is framed by tree branches and a railing, emphasizing the scenic overlook. No printed text is visible on the image side.
